stationScope.note: Two-station lane (lanes 1-3/5/6 shape): the substrate is UGM's two dedicated calculus stations; perSpecPoint resources may come from either station, plus 34 strays from five further stations (chain-rule 7, calculus-meets-functions 23, calculus-trig-log 1, product-rule 2, power-series 1) whose tested skill is 1.7.x.
